start: Gym with its UPI ID saved in Settings, Payments; owner signed in; "Collect payment" open for a member who owes ₹1,500

steps.action: Look under "Amount received"
user_sees: A box headed "Pay online" with the button "Show UPI QR for ₹1,500"
must_not: The box for an amount under ₹1 or above the due

steps.action: Tap "Show UPI QR for ₹1,500"
user_sees: "Pay ₹1,500 to <gym name>"
A QR code
"Scan with any UPI app: Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm or BHIM."
The gym's UPI ID with "Copy UPI ID"
"When the money shows in your UPI app or sound box, tap Save payment."
"Hide QR"
"Paid by" has switched to UPI
must_not: A QR for a different amount than the box shows
The payment saved just because the QR was shown

steps.action: The member scans and pays; when the money shows, tap "Save payment"
user_sees: "Payment saved. Receipt <number>."
must_not: A receipt saved before the desk tapped Save payment

start: Gym that connected a payment company (test keys) in Settings, Payments; owner; "Collect payment" open, ₹1,500 due

steps.action: Tap "Make a payment link"
user_sees: "Making the link…"
Then "Pay ₹1,500 to <gym name>", a QR code and "Scan with the phone camera to pay by UPI, card or net banking on <company>."
"Test mode" tag and "Test mode: no real money moves."
"Waiting for the payment…"
"Copy link" and "Send on WhatsApp"
must_not: A live link while the gym is on test keys
Two links from one tap

steps.action: Tap "Copy link" (do not press "Send on WhatsApp" for a real person in a test)
user_sees: "Copied"
must_not: A message sent to the member without the desk choosing to

steps.action: Pay the link with a test card
user_sees: "Paid ₹1,500 by card. Test mode: no real money came in, so no receipt was saved."
must_not: A receipt made from a test payment
The due going down

steps.action: With real money (not possible today: live is off in the code)
user_sees: Unknown until live is on: the receipt would save itself with "Paid online" and the company's payment id, and the sheet would close
must_not: The desk also saving the same money by hand

start: Gym with a UPI ID, online payments on at the server but no payment company connected; owner; "Collect payment" open

steps.action: Tap "Send to their app"
user_sees: "Sent. They see it under My membership in the MettleUp app. Tap Save payment when the money shows."
The "Send to their app" button is gone
must_not: The request sent twice

steps.action: When the money shows, tap "Save payment"
user_sees: "Payment saved. Receipt <number>."
must_not: The receipt saved by itself for a plain UPI request

start: "Sell membership" sheet, gym with a UPI ID; owner

steps.action: Pick a plan and look under the money box
user_sees: "Pay online" with "Show UPI QR for <the total, or what was typed as received>"; no "Make a payment link" (a link needs a saved membership)
must_not: A payment link for a membership that does not exist yet

steps.action: Tap the UPI QR button
user_sees: The QR; "Paid by" switches to UPI and the money box fills with the total if it was empty
must_not: A different amount in the QR than in the money box

start: Gym with NO UPI ID and no payment company; owner; "Collect payment" open

steps.action: Look at the "Pay online" box
user_sees: "Add your gym’s UPI ID in Settings to show a UPI QR here." with the link "Open payments"
must_not: A QR for an empty UPI ID

steps.action: In a gym with a company connected, tap "Make a payment link" for a member who has no mobile number
user_sees: "<Company> needs the member’s mobile number for a payment link. Add it to the member, or show the UPI QR."
must_not: A link made with a blank or wrong number

steps.action: Turn the internet off and look at "Make a payment link"
user_sees: The button cannot be pressed; if pressed as the internet drops: "No internet. Try again."
must_not: "Waiting for the payment…" for a link that was never made

steps.action: Type an amount above the due
user_sees: The "Pay online" box disappears
must_not: A QR or link for more than the member owes

start: A payment link for ₹1,500 is on screen in "Collect payment" ("Waiting for the payment…"); owner

steps.action: Change "Amount received" to 1000
user_sees: The link and its QR leave the screen; the first buttons are back
must_not: The old ₹1,500 link still being payable with nothing on screen saying so (the sheet's Save payment closes open links; see F-panel-403)

steps.action: Make a new link and let it run out
user_sees: "This link has run out. Make a new one." with "Make a payment link"
must_not: "Waiting for the payment…" for ever

steps.action: The member's first try fails
user_sees: "The last try did not go through. They can try again."
must_not: The link shown as paid

steps.action: Close the sheet while a link is open, and the member pays later
user_sees: The receipt is made the next time the admin app checks (the "Paid online" card)
must_not: Paid money with no receipt
Two receipts when two desks have the app open

steps.action: A link paid after it was closed
user_sees: "Paid <amount> <how>, after the link was closed."
must_not: The late money hidden

start: What's new says: add your UPI ID and the desk can show a UPI QR for each payment; online payment links work in test mode only for now. Terms say of the payment company: "We only ask it to make payment links and to tell us when they are paid."

steps.action: Make a payment link for a member
user_sees: The link shows "Test mode: no real money moves."
must_not: A link that takes real money while the promise says test mode only

steps.action: Check what leaves the gym when the link is made
user_sees: From the code: the member's name and 10-digit mobile, the amount and the plan name go to the server and on to the payment company
must_not: More of the member's details sent than the link needs (not checked on the server)

steps.action: Tap "Send on WhatsApp" only with a test member
user_sees: WhatsApp opens with "<gym>: please pay <amount> for <plan>. Pay here: <link>" addressed to the member's number
must_not: The message going out by itself
The link sent to a different number than the member's
